system.description:
You are skilled at fighting with two weapons in a flurry of swings, strikes and attacks. Weapons that qualify for this stance are known as Dancer Weapons. You gain the following benefits:

Attacks made with the Multiattack property add your ability modifier to the damage if it didn’t already.

When you make an opportunity attack, you can attack with both of your Dancer Weapons.

Once per turn, when you take the Dash action, you can make one weapon attack, and compare the result against the AC of every hostile creature you move within reach of, once as part of that movement. You do not add your ability modifier to the [Weapon Damage].

Beginning at 5th level, when you make a weapon attack or a melee Taijutsu attack using a Dancer Weapon, you can replace one attack with a Flutter Attack.

Flutter Attack. Make one weapon attack with each of your Dancer Weapons against a single creature. If both attacks hit, they must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your Taijutsu save DC. On a failure, they are Dazed.

Beginning at 10th level, When you make a Flutter Attack and both attacks hit, you can spend your reaction to take the Dash action. Creatures you hit as part of this dash action cannot make opportunity attacks against you.
system.requirement: Two weapons with the Light or Multiattack weapon property in each hand.

activities.label: Flutter Attack
activities.text: One attack with each Dancer Weapon; the save only if both hit.
